verdict.rationale: Browserbase markets web data extraction: agents that pull data from websites and URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown conversion. That makes large-table extraction a fair axis for this product. However, the evidence pack never mentions chunking large tables or handling processing or context limits, so general extraction claims are adjacent, not support for this story.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can extract data from very large tables using intelligent chunking so it fits within processing limits
